title: The board connects
_note: Locked dialogue from docs/VERTICAL_SLICE_SCRIPT.md. Arabic lives here, never in C++ source. Fires once ClaspFound, RosterAltered and LetterIsFalse are all set. Does NOT name Nofan as the architect - Three Names is Chapter 3.

lines.speaker: Evan
lines.en: Someone in this house moved the watch, wrote his hand, and put him on a boat that did not want to be seen.
lines.ar: أحدٌ في هذا البيت حرّك الحراسة، وزوّر خطّه، ووضعه في قارب لا يريد أن يُرى.

lines.speaker: Evan
lines.en: This is not a rival. This is us.
